objective: Close the execution-to-evidence-to-resolution gap without weakening evidence integrity: allow reported Quest v2 objective progress to be upgraded to verified at the same value through both memory and PostgreSQL gates, provide an executable evidence follow-through evaluator that prepares atomic quest.resolve only when every required objective is verified, and permit narrowly deterministic same-trajectory continuation after verified completion while preserving user control for strategic choices and all external writes.

roles_before.artifact: Ron or a stronger claim-specific live owner owns actual execution truth; System evidence cannot replace upstream truth.
quest.resolve atomically commits final verified objective progress, completion and canonical reward.
Quest v2 memory and PostgreSQL gates require a strictly larger numeric progress value, even when the only intended change is REPORTED to VERIFIED.
Quest creation and focus changes are user-directed except legacy focus preservation.
Maintenance automation may not play for Ron or create/complete/focus player quests.
Calendar, TickTick, Cronometer, Liftosaur, XMind, payments, messages and other external writes require separate exact permission.
Neon system_events remains the single append-only mutable owner of derived RPG state.
PostgreSQL system_validate_quest_v2_event is the production insert validator for Quest v2 progress and must behaviorally match the JS gate.
Current controller/runtime/database behavior is recoverable from the exact base SHA and Git history.

role_dispositions.destination: Evidence Follow-through v1 consumes only Ron-authoritative or stronger claim-specific evidence; it never upgrades evidence merely because a System event exists.
The existing atomic quest.resolve action remains the only routine scored-completion write; the new evaluator only prepares a policy-valid payload.

Numeric progress remains monotonic, but one same-value write is allowed only to upgrade the latest existing REPORTED claim to VERIFIED; equal reported duplicates, equal verified duplicates and all decreases remain rejected in both JS and PostgreSQL.

Strategic/cross-direction focus changes remain Ron-directed. A verified completion may auto-create/focus exactly one policy-valid same-trajectory continuation only when no material user choice, resource conflict, mandatory-reality conflict, stale source or external write exists.

Engineering automation still cannot fabricate player actions. The live player-facing System phase may perform only evidence-originated deterministic follow-through under system-evidence-followthrough:v1; absent qualifying evidence it remains read-only for player state.
Evidence follow-through authorizes no external mutation. Any external write still stops at PROTOCOL.md permission boundaries.
No second state owner, update/delete path or evidence warehouse is introduced; verification upgrades append a new validated progress event rather than mutating history.

Add idempotent migration 011 that redefines only the Quest v2 progress validator branch so the production PostgreSQL gate matches the JS same-value REPORTED-to-VERIFIED rule; no table/column/index/state-owner change.
The base SHA retains the previous user-directed continuation semantics and strict-increase progress gate; rollback restores the previous validator on service initialization.

capability_probes.assertion: Reported progress duplicates, verified duplicates after verification and numeric decreases remain rejected; normal increases still work in memory and PostgreSQL.

A full reported objective can be upgraded at the same numeric value to VERIFIED exactly once through both gates, eliminating the evidence dead-end without allowing progress rollback or duplicate spam.
The follow-through evaluator never prepares quest.resolve while any required objective lacks verified evidence.
Multiple candidates, cross-direction changes, mandatory/resource conflicts, stale/unknown source state, external writes or material choice return ASK_RON/STOP rather than autonomous continuation.
Quest focus, reward, achievement, shop, timing, profile, session and PWA/runtime regressions still pass.
The exact base SHA preserves the previous strict-increase and user-directed continuation behavior.

tests.expected: Verified bundles prepare atomic quest.resolve; reported/missing evidence does not; continuation auto-gate opens only for one safe same-trajectory candidate.
Same-value REPORTED to VERIFIED upgrade passes exactly once while old memory-gate monotonicity protections remain.
Migration 011 makes the production PostgreSQL gate accept exactly one same-value REPORTED-to-VERIFIED upgrade and reject a repeated VERIFIED duplicate.
The controller guard requires evidence follow-through boundaries while preserving strategic agency and external write gates.

verification.production_schema_mutation: BOUNDED FUNCTION-GATE MIGRATION — 011_evidence_followthrough_v1.sql changes only the Quest v2 PostgreSQL progress validation function behavior; no table, column, index, data-owner or player-state mutation is introduced.
verification.production_player_mutation: NONE DURING PROMOTION — current quest state is not changed by migration/deployment; follow-through waits for qualifying execution evidence.
